code_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.

code_error_wrong_kind_staff: This is a class code for attaching sites to a course. Enter it when creating your site, or in your site's settings.
code_error_already_enrolled: This site already belongs to another course. Leave that course first.
code_error_not_a_site: A course can't join another course.
accept_revoked: This invite has been cancelled. Ask the project convenor for a new link.
accept_used: This invite has already been used. Ask the project convenor for a new link.
accept_wrong_kind: This link isn't a project invitation.
invite_refused_course: Course projects don't send invitations. Create a join code instead.
remove_instructor_refused: Instructors come with the course. They can't be removed while this site is part of it.
team_page_intro: Everyone who joins this project is added to its GitHub repository. This page shows where each person stands.
repo_state_pending: Invitation sent. They have not accepted it yet.
repo_state_lapsed: The invitation expired before they accepted it.
repo_state_waiting: Not added to the repository yet.
repo_state_retrying: Adding them failed. The Compositor will try again.
repo_state_stopped: Adding them failed several times, so the Compositor has stopped trying. A convenor can try again.
repo_state_withdrawn: Their access to the repository was withdrawn.
repo_state_before: They joined before members were added automatically, so they are not on the repository.
repo_instructor_note: Instructors come with the course. Their access to the repository ends when they leave the course.
repo_own_lapsed: Your invitation expired, so it can't be accepted. A convenor can send you a new one from this page.
repo_error_changed: This changed since the page loaded, so nothing was done. The page now shows where they stand.
repo_error_owner: You can't withdraw the convenor's access to the repository.
repo_error_failed: GitHub didn't make the change. Try again in a moment.
repo_accept_fallback: We couldn't accept the invitation from here. You can accept it on GitHub instead.
repo_state_invited: Invited to the project. They have not followed the link to join yet.
